product.name: The Record
product.oneLiner: South African accountability timelines with law, constitution, and human-impact context.

flashcards.question: What architectural pattern is The Record?
flashcards.answer: Modular monolith: NestJS feature modules, single Postgres, FastAPI sidecar. Chosen for relational editorial domain and FK-heavy seeds, not independent service scaling.

flashcards.question: How does traffic reach the API in production?
flashcards.answer: Nginx terminates TLS and proxies to web on 127.0.0.1:3090. Web SSR uses API_URL (internal Docker) to api:3091. API is not directly published on host ports in prod compose.

flashcards.question: How is authentication implemented?
flashcards.answer: No end-user JWT. Public GET routes are open. Writes (ingestion, takedown, YouTube admin) require x-ingestion-key matching INGESTION_API_KEY via IngestionApiKeyGuard.

flashcards.question: What validates API input?
flashcards.answer: Global ValidationPipe: whitelist true, forbidNonWhitelisted true, transform true — unknown fields on DTOs are rejected before services.

flashcards.question: How are schema changes deployed?
flashcards.answer: TypeORM migrations with synchronize false. Deploy runs node dist/database/run-migrations.js inside API container after image build.

flashcards.question: How are money amounts stored?
flashcards.answer: bigint in Postgres for cost_rands; API serializes to string/number safely for JSON to avoid floating-point corruption on large totals.

flashcards.question: Why force-dynamic on data pages?
flashcards.answer: Accountability timelines and commission status change with ingestion and editorial updates; static caching would show stale legal/accountability state.

flashcards.question: How does the server avoid duplicate API calls per request?
flashcards.answer: React cache() wraps fetchers in lib/api.ts so generateMetadata and page components share one fetch per slug/tag per request.

flashcards.question: What triggers production deploy?
flashcards.answer: Push to main runs deploy.yml: SSH to Hetzner, git pull, docker compose up --build, migrations, state-entities seed, curl health.

flashcards.question: Biggest write-path risk?
flashcards.answer: INGESTION_API_KEY compromise allows article ingestion and Claude spend; no per-operator RBAC in code.

flashcards.question: Why ILIKE search?
flashcards.answer: Shipped unified search across 10 entity types with per-type cap (5) before investing in trigram/Meilisearch; known scan cost at scale.

flashcards.question: Why seeds instead of admin CMS?
flashcards.answer: Editorial accuracy rules require reviewable TS seeds and migrations; prevents unverified timeline rows in production.

flashcards.question: HistoricalLaw vs Law?
flashcards.answer: Repealed/colonial statutes live in historical_laws linked to HistoricalEra; active PRECCA/PFMA corpus stays in laws — never mixed in UI lists.

flashcards.question: How does RSS ingestion avoid overlap?
flashcards.answer: IngestionSchedulerService uses isRunning guard; cron gated by INGESTION_ENABLED===true; per-feed allSettled.

flashcards.question: Which RSS feeds are polled?
flashcards.answer: Daily Maverick, News24 (capi24 RSS with normalisation workaround), amaBhungane — every 15 minutes when enabled.

flashcards.question: Role of FastAPI intelligence service?
flashcards.answer: NLP/LLM operations (simplify law sections, ingestion pipeline steps) called from Nest via IntelligenceClient; keeps spaCy/Anthropic deps out of Node image.

flashcards.question: What does CI run?
flashcards.answer: typecheck web/api/shared-types, lint, api smoke with Postgres service + migrations, intelligence ruff/mypy, next build.

flashcards.question: What is a Story in the domain?
flashcards.answer: Core accountability thread: slug, domain/status/category, optional FKs to commission, adhoc, SIU, geography, SOE, impact sector; owns timeline events and people links.

flashcards.question: What is StoryTimeline?
flashcards.answer: Client component: vertical spine, Framer Motion, collapsible cards, EventTypeBadge, PlainEnglishBox, legal/constitution panels.

flashcards.question: What is impact_chain?
flashcards.answer: Ordered text array on story-impact join describing how corruption propagates to ordinary people — must end in human consequence not audit jargon.

flashcards.question: YouTube publish policy?
flashcards.answer: Review queue only; do not auto-publish below relevance score 0.4 per product rules.

flashcards.question: Monorepo packages?
flashcards.answer: npm workspaces: apps/web, apps/api, packages/shared-types; intelligence is separate Python app in apps/intelligence.

flashcards.question: CORS policy?
flashcards.answer: Explicit allowlist in main.ts: localhost dev ports, therecord.co.za, therecord.codist.co.za — credentials true.

flashcards.question: Health endpoints?
flashcards.answer: GET /api/health public; GET /api/health/full requires x-health-key and includes ingestion staleness checks.

flashcards.question: Why seed order matters?
flashcards.answer: FK dependencies: commissions before stories, impact-sectors before state-entities, sa-history after impact, mkhwanazi late for back-links.

flashcards.question: History API routes?
flashcards.answer: GET /api/history/eras, eras/:slug, laws, laws/:slug, timeline, compare — HistoryModule.

flashcards.question: Plain English levels?
flashcards.answer: child, layperson, legal — PlainEnglishBox component; history uses URL ?level= via client wrapper.

flashcards.question: Search must be server-side?
flashcards.answer: Yes — .cursorrules: always call /api/search, never client-side filter of props.

flashcards.question: Postgres down — user experience?
flashcards.answer: API health fails; web fetchers return null/empty paginated shells so pages degrade rather than throw during build.

flashcards.question: 10x users — first change?
flashcards.answer: PgBouncer + read replica for list/search; do not add app servers before fixing DB connection and scan-heavy search.

flashcards.question: Difficult technical decision?
flashcards.answer: Kept ingestion behind env flag and cron isolation so prod stays read-only archive until operators explicitly enable RSS+Claude spend.

flashcards.question: Production domain?
flashcards.answer: therecord.co.za canonical; codist subdomain legacy in CORS and docs; metadataBase should match cut-over checklist.

flashcards.question: spaCy version pin?
flashcards.answer: 3.7.4 pinned — do not upgrade without CI intelligence job passing.

flashcards.question: How many entities?
flashcards.answer: 46 TypeORM entity files including historical_era/event/law/statistic and state-entities, SIU, accountability bodies.

flashcards.question: BCE dates in history?
flashcards.answer: historical_events.year is signed int (e.g. -200000); year_display carries human string like '200,000 BCE'.

flashcards.question: docker restart gotcha?
flashcards.answer: Restart does not reload .env — need compose down/up for env changes per platform rules.

flashcards.question: Swagger in prod?
flashcards.answer: Disabled when NODE_ENV=production — only dev exposes /api/docs.

flashcards.question: Recent major feature?
flashcards.answer: South African history layer: eras, historical laws, /history UI, sa-history seed, HistoryModule API.

flashcards.question: Does deploy seed all corpora?
flashcards.answer: deploy.yml runs state-entities seed after migrations; sa-history and full mkhwanazi bundles are manual or need workflow addition — know what prod is missing after a history release.
followUps: How would you add sa-history to CI deploy?

flashcards.question: How do you ship timeline rows safely?
flashcards.answer: factual-timelines workspace rule: verify dates, named stats sources, article permalinks in source_urls, correct event_type, editorial tags for narrative beats — seeds are legal filings not filler.

behaviouralAnchors.question: Difficult decision with incomplete info
behaviouralAnchors.situation: Launching public site without user accounts
behaviouralAnchors.action: Public read + ingestion key for writes
behaviouralAnchors.result: Simpler compliance surface; documented key rotation
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Named threat model for key leak

behaviouralAnchors.question: Production issue
behaviouralAnchors.action: Migration in container post-build + health curl
behaviouralAnchors.result: Rollback via git revert + migration revert
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Migrations not in git pull alone

behaviouralAnchors.question: Balance speed and quality
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Refused to merge repealed acts into active laws

behaviouralAnchors.question: Complex feature E2E
behaviouralAnchors.result: Cross-links from stories to constitutional sectors
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Rejected audit-speak last step in chain

behaviouralAnchors.question: Performance improvement
behaviouralAnchors.action: cache() on api helpers + parallel Promise.all with null fallbacks
behaviouralAnchors.result: Stable TTFB under API outage for build

behaviouralAnchors.question: Disagreed with approach
behaviouralAnchors.seniorSignal: Pushed back on convenience that breaks consistency
